comparison.objective: Seat a shower cartridge and install its retaining U-clip, not tune an absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand holds a spring-backed cartridge flush while the other aligns and inserts a clip; no rotary calibration or trial cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Cartridge within 0.5 mm and 3 degrees, clip fully seated, and retention under 20 N pull versus repeatable controlled deceleration.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is shared only as a generic primitive; constrained clip insertion tests a different ability.
